growth_signal.value: Raised a $450M round in July 2026 at a $2.6B valuation, up from an €85M+ round and €25.5M seed the year before.

raised.note: confirmed by two sources in the run; the URLs were not saved

entry.idea: CuspAI uses generative AI to design new materials on demand, for uses like carbon capture and water purification.
entry.lesson: Point a powerful new AI method at a slow, expensive scientific search problem and you can shortcut years of lab work.
entry.name: CuspAI

growth.reason: Its valuation jumped roughly 20x in under two years across three funding rounds.

market.reason: New materials are needed across many large industries, from clean energy to water treatment, worldwide.

tech.reason: Generative AI for designing new materials from scratch is a rare, hard-to-copy capability backed by top investors and the UK government.

sources.title: UK government backs British AI startup CuspAI in $450M funding round
British startup CuspAI Secures €85 million+ to transform materials discovery with AI

entry.twist: Its AI does not just predict properties of known materials, it designs brand-new ones, something normally left to years of lab trial and error.
entry.who_pays: Industrial and government customers who need new materials for carbon capture and water purification.
entry.why_now: Governments and industry are racing to fund carbon capture and clean water technology, and AI can now search huge chemical spaces fast.
